body:
Severe, immediate vomiting upon taking the MDMA. I immediately had an excruciating headache, kidney area pain, neck pain, not to mention, I never felt the effects of the MDMA. I thought I had a stroke the pain was so intense. I continued vomiting and relaxed after showering. When I began MDMA usage (1988), my best friend and I would always be very depressed the next day and need what we called a 'no day' to rest and not have to think.
I will NEVER do MDMA again as long as I live. I was scared to death and I did it alot in high school. Over 10 years passed and I decided to do it again-what a mistake that was.
[Reported Dose: "1 to 2 tabs depending on which trip"]
